_about: Profile for the credential content factory. Copy over config/project.json (or pass --config). Values marked TUNE are starting points: set them on the first three pilot topics. Facts still come only from captured official sources or carry VERIFY (Credential Unit Standard); this profile adds machine checks, it does not relax that rule.
name: credential-content-factory

domain._note: one row per exam domain: id, credential, domain, level, hours, tier (Deep, Standard, Source-limited from DEPTH-AND-RIGOR-STANDARD section 5)

rules._note: the ids match standards/ADAPTIVE-MASTERY-METHODS.md (A = Part A rules, V = Part B visual rules, P = Part E practice aids)

sources._note: In specs, list captured official sources as {"type": "file", "path": "<capture>.txt", "label": "<issuer document>, retrieved <date>"}. Never paste blueprint text into a source pack without an owner decision (AGENTS.md).

labs._note: Free local labs only (Linux or WSL, containers, simulators). Labs needing a paid cloud account or credentials are procedures marked 'Not run' (COMPREHENSIVE-STUDY-STANDARD section 9). Extend the allow-list per credential, for example network or cloud CLI tools run against local simulators. Concept-only domains set min_commands to 0.

thresholds._note: TUNE. DEPTH-AND-RIGOR-STANDARD asks 4,000 to 6,000 words per domain page plus about 1,500 per companion. These minimums count the whole topic folder, so start lower than the CTF pilot and raise after reading the first three.

forbidden_facts._note: From Comprehensive Study Standard section 7: prices, passing scores, exam codes, version numbers, years and durations are not stated as facts unless a source register records them. A match is allowed only if the same text appears in a claims-register row. Tighten per credential.

models._note: Record the real models in provenance.json. Machine B (6 GB GPU) runs an 8-billion-parameter model at about 23 tokens/s; the 32 GB server runs a 32B model at about 25 tokens/s (pilot measurements).
